items.text: Delegate this to a subagent: find every function defined under src/ and list them with a one-line description. Then summarize the subagent result in two lines.

items.title: List functions under src
items.summary:
`src/` has one file, `<workspace>\src\math.js`, and it defines 2 functions:

| File | Function | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src/math.js` | `add(a, b)` | Exported; it is meant to add two numbers but returns `a - b`. |
| `src/math.js` | `mul(a, b)` | Exported; returns `a * b`. |

`add` has a bug: line 2 is `return a - b;`, so it subtracts instead of adding.

The file has no other functions, methods, classes or arrow functions. The repo root also has `test.js`, `package.json`, `README.md` and `diagram.png`, but those are outside `src/`, so I left them out.

The claude.ai Google Drive connector needs authorization before it can be used. You can do that in your claude.ai connector settings. This task didn't need it.
